summary: Owner-directed reversible UI release for Software subsite landing R1. Software remains presentation-only over Start-derived canonical resources. This release replaces the oversized loose landing composition with a compact mature hero and real metrics, a neutral install workspace, contained platform navigation, and a stronger purpose-directory card hierarchy. No Schema/migration, canonical data mutation, auth/security semantic change, updater mechanism change, provider/server state change, or Production write. Production remains Owner-manual.
